cover: AUTHOR-INITIATED CORRECTION REQUEST (draft 2026-10-14, revised 2026-10-27). Highlighted passages carry a note with the corrected statement; item numbers E1-E14 refer to correction_note.md and error_list.md in the author's repository (docs/paper_v2/correction/). Page numbers are those of this camera-ready copy; the published chapter is pp. 653-664.

items.title: Elo ratings withdrawn
items.note: The ratings (~4048, ~3724, ~3289), the comparison with Berserk/Lc0, Fig. 2, Table 6's dElo column and the '~435 Elo' statements are withdrawn. They were computed as an average over assumed opponent ratings plus clamped five-game logistic differences; the assumed ratings were never measured and the game records were not retained. Corrected: no rating for any mode is to be inferred from the chapter; the controlled hybrid-vs-AB measurement is reported in the follow-up preprint.

items.title: The alpha-beta engine is Stockfish
items.note: Corrected: the alpha-beta engine is Stockfish's search and NNUE evaluation (Stockfish dev of 2026-01-03 at the time; Stockfish 19 now, bench signature 2,497,913) with eight small local edits; no GPU integration in the search; no killer-move heuristic. The 100% agreement with Stockfish follows from the searches being the same program and validates nothing; every MetalFish-AB strength statement is a statement about Stockfish.

items.title: Nodes are 128 bytes, not 64
items.note: Corrected: on Apple Silicon Node is alignas(128) with static_assert(sizeof(Node) <= 128), so each node occupies exactly one 128-byte cache line (already so at the chapter's commit). 64-byte nodes exist only in non-Apple builds. 'Two nodes per cache line' and Sect. 6.3 item (3) are withdrawn.

items.title: 74x improvement unsupported
items.note: Corrected: the 2 NPS baseline was a lock-convoy defect in an unpreserved development build; no measurement record exists; the 74x figure and 'a 74x multi-threaded speedup' are withdrawn. os_unfair_lock remains in use. Other Table 1 rows are single runs without variance. The hybrid runs one MCTS worker by default, so multi-threaded MCTS throughput is not exercised in the evaluated mode.

items.title: NN cache figures wrong
items.note: Corrected: with 96 moves per entry an entry is about 820 bytes, so 500,000 entries occupy about 0.41 GB (not 38 MB); the reduction from the 218-move, 2,000,000-entry layout (about 3.6 GB) is about 9x, not 92x. The full-history key (0% hit rate) was true at the time; since 2026-05-15 the key covers the current position only. Current defaults: 2,000,000 entries (about 1.65 GB) for stand-alone MCTS, 100,000 in the hybrid.

items.title: TT and NNUE sizes misstated
items.note: Corrected: the transposition-table size is the UCI Hash option, default 16 MB (512 MB was the tournament setting, Sect. 5.1). Networks at the time: nn-c288c895ea92.nnue, 108.9 MB (FullThreats + HalfKAv2_hm, L1 = 1024) and nn-37f18f62d772.nnue, 3.5 MB (HalfKAv2_hm, L1 = 128). Current release: single Stockfish 19 network nn-1a298aa575a0.nnue, 98.5 MB.

items.title: Classifier does not weight the decision; Fig. 1 routing wrong
items.note: Corrected: the classifier's weighting fields are computed but read by no code outside the classifier and its unit tests (chapter's commit and current release); the final-move decision does not depend on the position class. The classifier only scales the per-move time budget and sets the minimum MCTS node count for the agreement stop. Engine mode is selected by UCI options (UseHybridSearch, UseMCTS), not by the classifier; Fig. 1's routing is wrong.

items.title: Early termination: no time saving measured
items.note: Corrected: the agreement stop exists but is gated (clock games only; three consecutive coordinator polls about 1.5 ms apart, not iterations; more than 25% of the budget elapsed; at least 100 MCTS playouts; AB depth at least 10). It fired 0 of 209 times in the retained July 2026 telemetry (a build later than the chapter's); in the current engine it fires rarely (3 of the 3,278 moves with the transformer active in a 30+0.3 pilot, October 2026). No time-saving measurement exists; '10-40%' is withdrawn.

items.title: NN influence inference wrong; BK suite at ceiling
items.note: Corrected: in the retained telemetry the hybrid's final move was the alpha-beta move in 207 of 209 decisions (20+0.2, July 2026); in a 100-game 30+0.3 pilot of the current engine (October 2026) the MCTS move was selected in none of the 1,165 decisions where the two searches disagreed. Agreement with Lc0 reflects Stockfish/Lc0 agreement on these positions. The 24-position suite is at ceiling (a later 5 s run: AB 20, MCTS 24, Hybrid 24, Lc0 18, Stockfish 20) and was used during tuning; Tables 2-3 are not a ranking.

items.title: Throughput vs Lc0 withdrawn
items.note: Corrected: Table 4 rests on four 10 s positions and Lc0's 14 nps in the 'Complex middlegame' row indicates a harness fault. Measured on M2 Max with no game running and the same BT4 network (2026-10-13): MetalFish Metal FP16 135 positions/s at batch 1 (7.4 ms), the setting it plays with, and at best 538 (batch 64); an Lc0 0.32.1 Metal search 165 nodes/s at minibatch 1 and at best 725 (minibatch 32). MetalFish's evaluation rate is below Lc0's search rate at batch 1 and at each program's best batch size (above at batch 2-8, below at 16 and 32, about equal at 64); the tools count different things, so the comparison is indicative only. The 1.26x advantage is withdrawn.

items.title: M1 Ultra figures and 7.24x scaling unsupported
items.note: Corrected: no measurement record exists for 9.8M NPS, 7.24x scaling or ~382 NPS on M1 Ultra; withdrawn. Measured on M2 Max (2026-10-13; fixed depth 16, median of five runs, 1 GB hash): 1.53M nps on one thread, 11.81M on eight (7.7x), 13.52M on twelve.

items.title: Related work mischaracterised
items.note: Corrected: Baier and Winands [9] embed shallow minimax searches within MCTS selection, rollout and backpropagation (not 'sequential', not a survey). Lanctot et al. [10] evaluated implicit minimax backups on Kalah, Breakthrough and Lines of Action, not in general game playing.

items.title: Time manager not used by the hybrid
items.note: Corrected: the Lc0-style smooth time manager is used by the stand-alone MCTS mode only. Within the hybrid at the chapter's commit, Stockfish's time manager set the move time and the MCTS component ran until the alpha-beta search finished (hard cap at 76% of the remaining time).

items.title: Omitted time-safety fallback
items.note: Omission: the hybrid disables its transformer component and plays the alpha-beta move whenever the remaining time or the fixed move time is below a threshold (5 s at the chapter's commit; 3 s remaining or a move budget below 0.4 s in the current release). The transformer was active on 52% of hybrid moves at 20+0.2, about 50% at 30+0.3 and almost never at 10+0.1; hybrid results at short time controls are largely alpha-beta results.
